availability: Only use values when their realtime_start date was reached, then end of that date in America/New_York plus one complete canonical XAU D1 interval. Never backfill first-created series into prior decisions.

observed_source_limit.message: You may only download 450 vintages at one time for a frequency of Daily. Currently, you have 4182 vintage dates specified.
observed_source_limit.source: ALFRED form validation after DFII10 request with 4182 vintages

purpose: Validate already fetched archives only; no network, predictor construction or fits.
submission: For each of the four named series, read all advertised vintages within the same bounds, sort and partition into consecutive non-overlapping batches of at most 450. One normal Download data click per batch. Stop on any failed batch, rate limit, authentication or CAPTCHA. Preserve completed batches for reuse; never restart them.
transport: Codex in-app browser on Mac, native public download form. No API key, account creation or billing.
validation: ZIP CRC and byte hashes; exact source ID/units/format; all four CSV columns; parsed date bounds; finite numeric values or declared missing; ordered nonoverlapping real-time intervals per observation; no duplicate observation/start tuples; README vintages equal selected dates. Current open-ended intervals may have blank ends. Future revision end metadata is not a feature. Union of README vintage lists must equal the complete advertised bounded list with no gaps or duplicate vintage selections. Repeated observation/version rows across chunks must be identical and deduplicated for audit only; mismatching duplicates fail qualification.
vintage_selection: Read advertised options in calendar-year groups to avoid the browser-tool array-output cap; concatenate and verify unique sorted set exactly equals all bounded DOM options. Partition this complete set into consecutive chunks of at most 450. Verify selected options equal each declared chunk before click. Record SHA256 of newline-separated dates with final newline per series and chunk; README dates must match each hash.
